amendments.before: On morgen, ðā hīe fōron, and hīe būton byrig wǣron, and fōron sumne dǣl ðæs weges, ðā cwæð Iosep tō his gerēfan: Ārīs, and gā æfter ðissum mannum; and ðonne ðū hīe fō, ðonne āsca hīe hwȳ hīe wolden gōd mid yfele forgieldan.
amendments.after: On morgen, ðā hīe fōron, and hīe būtan byrig wǣron, and fōron sumne dǣl ðæs weges, ðā cwæð Iosep tō his gerēfan: Ārīs, and gā æfter ðissum mannum; and ðonne ðū hīe fō, ðonne āsca hīe hwȳ hīe wolden gōd mid yfele forgieldan.
amendments.reason: Use the actually taught preposition spelling būtan for outside/without, with the new spatial sense separately supplied. Preserve conjunction būton elsewhere. No word position changes.
